objective: Test whether the proven order branch between layer-0 projected output and layer-1 GDN normalized input is removed by the existing packed-serial Qwen/Gemma outer RMSNorm/residual path.

single_variable.name: VLLM_XPU_QWEN_GEMMA_RMSNORM_PACKED_SERIAL_EXACT
single_variable.note: The implementation is already present and operator-qualified in the R108 lineage. R109 changes no source, projection treatment, scheduler setting, prompt, or oracle.

workload.warmup: One c1 and two c2 repeats.
workload.qualification: Three c1 and twenty c2 repeats, 128 output tokens, frozen complete token-ID oracle.

required_gate.outputs: 3/3 c1 and 20/20 c2 batches exact; complete 128-token streams; cached tokens zero.
required_gate.trace: Both TP ranks present, projection execution retained, and order-dependent normalized/projected layer-prompt pairs reduced from R108's 94/96 to zero if the candidate is causal.
required_gate.health: No new xe reset, GPU fault, OOM kill, storage error, or malformed response.

decision.passes: Treat as a causal combined candidate only. Remove the rejected projection-isolation treatment in a follow-up factorial, then run fresh-server realistic quality and performance qualification.
decision.fails: Reject the outer RMSNorm/residual gate as sufficient and trace the layer-0 decoder residual/add/input-normalization boundary directly.

resource_boundary: Use 12 GiB container RAM and 16 GiB RAM-plus-swap; no reboot or GPU reset.
reporting_boundary: No public speed, README headline, website, or LocalMaxxing update from this diagnostic.
